title: Neuroimmune Communication in Health and Disease Conference
level: Scientists and graduate students (bachelor's degree in science/engineering required)
about: The 2027 Gordon Research Conference "Neuroimmune Communication in Health and Disease" will take place from 24 to 29 January 2027 at the Ventura Beach Marriott in Ventura, United States. Applications must be submitted by 27 December 2026 through the conference page on grc.org.
requirements: Undergraduates or those without a bachelor's degree in science/engineering (or acceptable equivalent) are not eligible to apply (GRC policy)
